source: Dad...
translation: 爸爸……

source: What should I do...?
translation: 我该怎么办……？

source: A-Ah, there you are…!
translation: 啊、啊，你在这里……！

source: …Yoshi?
translation: ……Yoshi？

source: I thought I’d find you here…!
translation: 我就知道能在这里找到你……！

source: Y-Yeah! I was just getting some air…!
translation: 是、是啊！我只是出来透透气……！

source: Mind if I come up there?
translation: 介意我上去吗？

source: A-Are you sure you wanna stay up here with me…? It’s pretty cold…
translation: 你、你确定要和我待在上面吗……？这里很冷……

source: I’ll be alright, but what about you?
translation: 我没问题，可你呢？

source: I’m fine. Today’s not as cold as yesterday.
translation: 我没事。今天不像昨天那么冷。

source: That’s good…
translation: 那就好……

source: Hey, Aiden, I…
translation: 嘿，Aiden，我……

source: …I’m sorry about being so persistent earlier.
translation: ……对不起，刚才一直逼迫你。

source: I was so focused on trying to encourage you about the offer, even though I knew it was bothering you.
translation: 明知那份邀请让你困扰，我却一心只想鼓励你接受。

source: I-It’s okay, Yoshi… I knew you and everyone else were only trying to help.
translation: 没、没关系，Yoshi……我知道你和其他人都只是想帮忙。

source: I’m really sorry for the way I lashed out, too…
translation: 我那样大发脾气，也真的很抱歉……

source: I didn’t mean to walk out on you like that, I just panicked ’cause I didn’t want to say anything worse…
translation: 我不是故意那样丢下你离开，只是慌了，不想说出更伤人的话……

source: It's not your fault, Aiden... I know how big of a decision this is for you…
translation: 这不是你的错，Aiden……我知道这个决定对你有多重大……

source: But please let me help clear up your worries... and convince you why this opportunity is the best thing for you!
translation: 但请让我帮你消除顾虑……也让我告诉你，为什么这个机会最适合你！

source: And maybe for us…
translation: 也许也最适合我们……

source: You don’t have to anymore…
translation: 你已经不必再这么做了……

source: While I was alone, I was able to think about it... and I realized... you're right...
translation: 独处时，我认真想了想……然后意识到……你是对的……

source: I’m deliberately missing out on a life-changing opportunity that everyone knows is best for me…
translation: 我正在故意错过一个能改变人生、所有人都知道最适合我的机会……

source: And to think that my reason for turning it down was just because I was so afraid to be away from you.
translation: 而我拒绝它的理由，居然只是太害怕与你分开。

source: I… didn’t want to be alone again…
translation: 我……不想再次孤身一人……

source: When we got separated, I lost touch with you completely…
translation: 我们分开后，我彻底失去了与你的联系……

source: Being far away doesn’t excuse the fact that I didn’t put in the effort to try and reconnect…
translation: 相隔遥远并不能成为借口，我根本没有努力尝试重新联系你……

source: I was wrapped up in my own goals, and just expected things to be the same when I came back.
translation: 我一心扑在自己的目标上，只想着回来后一切仍会保持原样。

source: But I was the same, Yoshi… We had to go through our own lives, so I never blamed you for that…
translation: 可我也一样，Yoshi……我们都必须过自己的生活，所以我从没因此责怪你……

source: In my head, I couldn’t reach out to you until I had something to show for myself.
translation: 在我心里，除非自己做出些成绩，否则就没脸联系你。

source: Even still… If I had only tried, then I would’ve known about what you had to go through…
translation: 即便如此……如果我当时尝试过，就会知道你经历了什么……

source: It wasn’t even until today that I found out you and your dad had to leave Camp Buddy after the first term…
translation: 直到今天我才知道，你和父亲在第一期结束后就不得不离开伙伴营……

source: H-How did you know that?
translation: 你、你怎么知道的？

source: From Sir Goro…
translation: Goro先生告诉我的……

source: I-I understand why you kept that from me, though…
translation: 不、不过我理解你为什么对我隐瞒……

source: It was a difficult time for you, I can't even comprehend how much you both had to go through in the last few years...
translation: 那段时间对你很艰难，我甚至无法想象你们两人在过去几年里经历了多少……

source: I-I’m sorry… I knew you were trying your best to lock those memories away…
translation: 对、对不起……我知道你一直努力把那些回忆封存起来……

source: I didn’t think I could keep a secret like that forever either…
translation: 我也没想过这种秘密能永远瞒下去……

source: I’ll admit that times were tough back then…
translation: 我承认，当时的日子确实很艰难……

source: As soon as we left Camp Buddy, Dad and I had to fend for ourselves again, and he kept trying to push himself to work despite being sick...
translation: 刚离开伙伴营，我和爸爸就只能再次自力更生，而他明明病着，却仍不断逼自己工作……

source: He worked twice as hard, wanting to make sure that we didn't end up in the life we had before.
translation: 他加倍努力工作，只想确保我们不会再次过上从前的生活。

source: But it only made his health worse, and he still wasn't making enough to afford his medication...
translation: 可这只让他的健康继续恶化，而收入依然不足以支付药费……

source: Just like he'd given up on his dream before, he was going to give himself up for me, and I couldn't let that happen...
translation: 就像他以前放弃梦想一样，他准备为了我牺牲自己，而我不能允许那种事发生……

source: After everything I learned at Camp Buddy and the way you believed in me, I wanted to prove how capable I could be.
translation: 在伙伴营学到一切，又得到你的信任后，我想证明自己究竟有多大能力。

source: So, I asked Dad to let me take over...
translation: 所以，我请求爸爸让我来承担一切……

source: I went out there and got all sorts of jobs to make enough money for the both of us, and to afford Dad’s medication.
translation: 我出去做了各种工作，努力赚够我们两人的生活费和爸爸的药费。

source: I’d come back home from a long day of work and still find the time to take care of Dad, and he’d always try to show me that he was happy.
translation: 每天辛苦工作回家后，我依然会挤出时间照顾爸爸，而他总会努力表现出开心的样子。

source: He never forgot to tell me how proud he was of me… And I was too.
translation: 他从不会忘记告诉我，他有多么为我骄傲……而我也同样为自己骄傲。

source: As difficult as our life was, the struggles felt worth it…
translation: 无论生活多么艰难，那些付出都让我觉得值得……

source: That’s one thing that never changed about Mr. Andre…
translation: Andre先生这一点从来没有改变……

source: Yeah, Dad’s always been my role model…
translation: 是啊，爸爸一直是我的榜样……

source: He always managed to turn something bad around, and found a reason to appreciate the littlest things, despite his illness.
translation: 即使身患疾病，他也总能把坏事往好处想，并找到欣赏生活中点滴事物的理由。

source: His condition was bound to get worse over time, so as the years went by, the smile on Dad’s face began to fade away…
translation: 他的病情注定会随着时间恶化，所以随着岁月流逝，爸爸脸上的笑容也开始逐渐消失……

source: We spent as much time together as we could, doing things we loved.
translation: 我们尽可能多地待在一起，做着我们喜欢的事。

source: Up until his final moments…
translation: 直到他生命的最后时刻……

source: Aiden… I’m so sorry…
translation: Aiden……我真的很抱歉……

source: It’s crazy to think that I was gonna walk away from the chance, just because I was too afraid to get out of my comfort zone…
translation: 真难以想象，我竟然差点因为害怕走出舒适区，就放弃了这个机会……

source: This was dad's dream, and he would've been so proud to see me fulfill it... So I can't take this huge opportunity for granted...
translation: 这是爸爸的梦想，如果他能看到我实现这个梦想，一定会感到无比骄傲……所以，我不能不珍惜这次天大的机会……

source: I shouldn’t be so selfish… If I’m not going to do it for myself, I should at least do it for you and my dad since you’ve both supported me for so long.
translation: 我不该这么自私……如果我不愿意为了自己去做，至少也该为了你和爸爸去做，毕竟这么多年来一直是你们支持着我。

source: But you’re doing this for yourself too, Aiden…
translation: 但你也是为了自己才这么做的，Aiden……

source: You really deserve this because you’ve worked so hard all your life.
translation: 你一生都这么努力，真的值得拥有这个机会。

source: You’re right, Yoshi…
translation: 你说得对，Yoshi……

source: I’ve always endured whatever life throws at me, and for some goddamn reason, I’m getting in my own way this time.
translation: 生活抛给我的一切，我一直都能扛过去，可这一次，也不知道该死的为什么，我却成了自己的绊脚石。

source: This isn’t the time to be doubting myself…! I need to believe in myself more!
translation: 现在不是怀疑自己的时候……！我得更加相信自己！

source: That’s the right way to think about it, Aiden!
translation: 这才是正确的想法，Aiden！

source: I’m glad you finally see now why all of us were guiding you in this direction!
translation: 我很高兴你终于明白我们大家为什么一直引导你走向这个方向！

source: You’ll be the best chef out there, I’m sure!
translation: 我相信你一定会成为最优秀的厨师！

source: Th-Thanks, Yoshi…
translation: 谢、谢谢你，Yoshi……

source: And don’t worry about being away! We can always keep in touch, send gifts, and maybe even meet up at a restaurant you’ll be working in!
translation: 也别担心分隔两地！我们随时可以保持联系、互送礼物，说不定还可以在你工作的餐厅见面！

source: I’d really appreciate that, Yoshi… That’s all I’ll need…
translation: 我会很感激的，Yoshi……这些就够了……

source: Of course! All of us here at Camp Buddy will be there for you!
translation: 当然！Camp Buddy 的所有人都会支持你的！

source: {i}Thankfully, I was able to help Aiden clear up his doubts and steer him towards the right path.{/i}
translation: {i}幸好，我成功帮Aiden消除了疑虑，引导他走上了正确的道路。{/i}

source: {i}I'm going to make sure to support him any way that I can, so that he doesn't have to hesitate anymore!{/i}
translation: {i}我一定会尽我所能支持他，让他不必再犹豫！{/i}
